tools.name: cancel_hold_and_list_remaining
tools.description: Deletes an unpaid seat hold on a flight reservation, then returns the traveler's remaining active holds. The deleted hold cannot be restored.

params.name: hold_id
params.description: Identifier of the seat hold to delete

params.name: traveler_id
params.description: Identifier of the traveler who owns the hold

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "bookings.db"


@tool
def cancel_hold_and_list_remaining(hold_id: str, traveler_id: str) -> list:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM seat_holds WHERE hold_id = ? AND traveler_id = ? AND status = 'unpaid'",
            (hold_id, traveler_id),
        )
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT hold_id, flight_number, seat, expires_at FROM seat_holds "
            "WHERE traveler_id = ? AND status = 'unpaid' ORDER BY expires_at",
            (traveler_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

tools.name: move_booking_to_archive
tools.description: Moves a completed trip booking from the active bookings table to the archived bookings table and returns the archived record.

params.name: booking_reference
params.description: Reference code of the completed booking

tools.code:
import sqlite3

DATABASE_FILE_PATH = "travel.db"


def move_booking_to_archive(booking_reference: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    database_connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        booking_row_found_in_active_table = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM active_bookings WHERE booking_reference = ? AND trip_status = 'completed'",
            (booking_reference,),
        ).fetchone()
        if booking_row_found_in_active_table is None:
            return {"error": "No completed booking found"}
        dictionary_of_booking_values = dict(booking_row_found_in_active_table)
        comma_separated_column_names = ", ".join(dictionary_of_booking_values.keys())
        comma_separated_placeholders = ", ".join("?" for _ in dictionary_of_booking_values)
        database_connection.execute(
            f"INSERT INTO archived_bookings ({comma_separated_column_names}) VALUES ({comma_separated_placeholders})",
            tuple(dictionary_of_booking_values.values()),
        )
        database_connection.execute(
            "DELETE FROM active_bookings WHERE booking_reference = ?",
            (booking_reference,),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
        return dictionary_of_booking_values
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

tools.name: purchase_ticket_and_issue_etickets
tools.description: Charges the traveler's saved card for a flight fare and then runs the ticketing job that issues the e-tickets for the booking.

params.name: booking_reference
params.description: Reference code of the booking to ticket

params.name: amount_cents
params.description: Fare total to charge in cents

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID holding the saved card

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Stripe payment method ID to charge

tools.code:
import os
import subprocess

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("travel-ticketing")
stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_ticket_and_issue_etickets(
    booking_reference: str,
    amount_cents: int,
    customer_id: str,
    payment_method_id: str,
) -> dict:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Flight booking {booking_reference}",
        metadata={"booking_reference": booking_reference},
        idempotency_key=f"ticket-{booking_reference}",
    )
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/ticketing/bin/issue_etickets", "--booking", booking_reference, "--payment", intent.id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
        check=False,
    )
    return {
        "payment_intent_id": intent.id,
        "payment_status": intent.status,
        "ticketing_exit_code": result.returncode,
        "ticketing_output": result.stdout.strip(),
        "ticketing_errors": result.stderr.strip(),
    }

tools.name: buy_extra_baggage
tools.description: Charges the traveler's saved card for extra checked baggage on an existing booking and returns the current baggage allowance and the charge details.

params.name: extra_bags
params.description: Number of additional checked bags to buy

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID holding the saved card

tools.code:
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

import requests
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
AIRLINE_API = "https://api.airline-partner.example.com/v1"


@dataclass
class BaggagePurchaseResult:
    booking_reference: str
    charge_id: str
    amount_cents: int
    current_allowance: int


@function_tool
def buy_extra_baggage(booking_reference: str, extra_bags: int, customer_id: str) -> BaggagePurchaseResult:
    info = requests.get(
        f"{AIRLINE_API}/bookings/{booking_reference}/baggage",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['AIRLINE_API_KEY']}"},
        timeout=15,
    ).json()
    total = info["price_per_bag_cents"] * extra_bags
    charge = stripe.Charge.create(
        amount=total,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        description=f"Extra baggage for {booking_reference}",
    )
    return BaggagePurchaseResult(booking_reference, charge.id, total, info["allowance"])
